summary: Diff includes deployment/rebuild helper artifacts (scripts/docs) but also appears to introduce new backend quote/lead functionality and multiple frontend routing/UI changes, which conflict with the request to rebuild/redeploy without feature changes.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend quote/lead capture and admin quote management (new ServiceQuote types, quotes storage, requestServiceQuote, getQuote/getQuotes/updateQuote, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 explicitly requires a rebuild/redeploy without introducing feature changes; new quote/lead domain objects and endpoints constitute new backend functionality.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend route/IA changes: LandingPage at "/" and StorefrontPage moved to "/products" (and related navigation updates).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 disallows feature changes; changing core route mapping and navigation is a user-facing behavior change.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin area expanded navigation/features (e.g., Admin nav includes "Leads" and "Users").
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1 and implies additional admin functionality beyond a rebuild/redeploy.

hallucinated_features.description: UI/styling changes including a new blue-forward global palette and assorted component visual changes (e.g., placeholder fallbacks, hover effects, enhanced homepage sections).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints/non-goals disallow styling/theme/copy changes unless required to fix a build-breaking issue; the diff summary describes broad styling/UI updates without tying them to a build fix.

hallucinated_features.description: Deep-link & SPA routing behavior additions (404.html redirect/sessionStorage restore and main.tsx restoration) and ShareButton behaviors documented as required checks.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of REQ-1 and appears to introduce/require additional functionality; also references changes to an immutable path (main.tsx) at least in documentation, which is risky against constraints.
